request_priority: Assemble complete logical flows before physical validation and resource/timing iteration; preserve old candidates and other branches.
source_policy: Maintenance RTL and explicit locked baseline member; no historical private staging, text overlay or dimension overlay.
implemented_flows: One real M SD/FAT/WAV owner exclusively routes playback or backpressurable offline analysis. Basic synth scheduling remains independent.
M bounded source automatically partitions a file into <=96000-frame clips without losing the decode cursor, sends ordered descriptor/PCM/seal, and waits for each validated terminal.
W real task service accepts deferred final CRC only in explicit new mode; actual native writes and full readback CRC precede real model/CQT/CNN/Viterbi replay.
M accumulates ordered complete clip scores in a bounded2048-note image and publishes Push notes only after actual file-final success.
W PCM1 and clock callers use one command proxy with identity/sequence/timeout; M routes application to its existing PCM owner or clock service.
M pulse-only final serializer-completion tap uses a bounded queue and explicit W arm-result acknowledgement before delivery to maintained recording ingress.
Recording ingress is the existing HCI single-object source boundary, not a second recorder. Unique raw DDR backend/CPU/BLE download remain the maintained W services.
Bounded independent queues preserve ready/valid stability and order; cancellation/link loss/PANIC revoke stale work without waiting for base sample credit.
review_fixes: Prevent actual task acceptance on a same-cycle START cancellation.
Wait for native track application before evaluating old decoder state; treat empty playback as explicit failure.
Only cancel a currently selected analysis cursor on source failure; a late old result cannot cancel a later playback cursor.
Separate link cancellation from native DDR fatal transport fault.
Hold remote PCM/clock address through PREPARE before command valid for real clock predecode.
Convert held recording frame valid to registered pulse/credit delivery; wait for explicit remote arm result.

communication_budget.scope: Internal transaction costs only; no physical LCD framing/clock/CRC/credit or measured bandwidth is selected.

limits: The new roots are same-clock logical pair compositions, not physical M/W board tops or a CDC acceptance.
New paired profiles still need actual W owner5/6/8 DDR/HCI single-object and M final-owner/display composition bindings. Existing accepted candidates do not select this framework.

Source/collector and deferred lifecycle fixtures use explicit deterministic response sinks where stated; they do not prove real CNN quality. Full actual-model evidence belongs to the prior immutable BSRAM candidate.
No complete real SD-to-LCD-to-CNN-to-Push integration run, real HCI/SBC/D DSP concurrency, long recording/download concurrency or measured physical output is covered.
The TF route was fully elaborated with actual dependencies; the newly added route lifecycle is not a full SPI behavioral or physical-card acceptance.
Recognition currently accepts48k stereo16 only. Clip concatenation lacks cross-window musical-context stitching; score capacity2048 fails explicitly on overflow.
No new whole-board resource count, routed STA, PLL/CDC acceptance, bitstream, physical latency, SRAM or Flash operation. Prior308BSRAM/3.225s evidence is not inherited.
The reverse LCD cable requires continuity, power isolation, voltage, direction and clock verification before any physical IO selection.
